name: martinloop
description: Independent governance and authorization layer for autonomous AI coding-agent execution.
long_description: MartinLoop governs autonomous software work with budgets, verification gates, controlled execution, recovery, rollback evidence, and auditable run receipts. It runs locally so it can inspect and govern work inside user-approved repositories without uploading source code to a hosted MartinLoop service.

workspace_root.title: Workspace repository
workspace_root.description: The repository or workspace MartinLoop is allowed to inspect and govern.

runs_root.title: MartinLoop run storage
runs_root.description: Local directory used for MartinLoop receipts, evidence, and run records.

live_mode.title: Enable live execution
live_mode.description: Allow tools that can start or control live agent execution. Leave disabled for inspection-only use.
